mcp_config.server_provider: Atlassian Rovo official (Cloud) -- use mcp-atlassian community server instead if Server/Data Center
mcp_config.server_address_or_command: REPLACE: your Atlassian site's Rovo MCP endpoint, OR mcp-atlassian launch command with JIRA_URL/CONFLUENCE_URL env vars

temporal_strategy.t_recorded_source: Jira changelog entry timestamp (never poll time, per §5.2's explicit Jira pitfall); Confluence page revision timestamp
temporal_strategy.known_pitfalls: Must use the changelog/history API, not diff-by-polling -- a naive poll-and-diff connector misattributes all changes since last poll to 'now' (§5.2's documented Jira pitfall, applies identically whether reached via MCP or direct REST).
